data.one_liner: Reactive stream wrapper around SharedPreferences for key-value storage.
data.what_it_does: Wraps SharedPreferences with RxDart streams, allowing developers to observe changes to keys reactively. It supports standard data types, objects with decoders, and provides methods to read, write, update, and listen to streams of stored values.
use_when: You want to reactively listen to changes in SharedPreferences using RxDart streams
You need a lightweight key-value storage solution with stream observation capabilities
avoid_when: You require complex relational queries or large-scale offline databases
You are not using RxDart or reactive programming paradigms
strengths: Provides clean stream-based observation of SharedPreferences keys
Requires very little code to integrate
Supports custom objects via decoders and encoders
weaknesses: Returns single-subscription streams that must be handled accordingly
data.setup_notes: Wrap your SharedPreferences instance in RxSharedPreferences before usage.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer standard asynchronous Future-based calls without RxDart dependencies.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a faster, feature-rich NoSQL key-value database instead of standard shared preferences.
